docs.title: Terraform Modules
docs.text: This site documents the Terraform modules used to provision SAP BTP subaccounts, enable Cloud Foundry, and subscribe to SAP Build Work Zone.

docs.title: Modules
docs.text:
• BTPSA creates a SAP BTP subaccount, establishes trust with SAP Cloud Identity Services, and assigns platform administrator and viewer groups.
  • BTPCF enables a Cloud Foundry environment in an existing subaccount.
  • BTP Workzone creates the Cloud Foundry resources and SAP BTP subscription required for SAP Build Work Zone and Task Center.

docs.title: Deployment Order
docs.text:
Apply the modules in the following order:

  1. Create the subaccount with BTPSA.
  2. Enable Cloud Foundry with BTPCF, using the subaccount ID and subdomain outputs.
  3. Configure Workzone after the Cloud Foundry organization is available.

Each module is versioned independently. Select the documentation version that matches the module version used in your Terraform configuration.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Terraform 1.14.0 or later.
  • Credentials and permissions for the SAP BTP Terraform provider.
  • Cloud Foundry credentials and permissions when using the Workzone module.
  • A SAP Cloud Identity Services tenant for platform and business-user trust configuration.

Configure providers in the root configuration that calls a module. Modules do not configure provider authentication themselves.

docs.title: Typical Workflow
docs.text:
1. Initialize the root configuration with terraform init.
  2. Review the proposed infrastructure with terraform plan.
  3. Apply the subaccount module and retain its ID and subdomain outputs.
  4. Apply the Cloud Foundry module, then wait for the environment to finish provisioning.
  5. Apply the Workzone module with the Cloud Foundry organization ID.

Run terraform destroy only after confirming that dependent SAP BTP subscriptions, Cloud Foundry service instances, and application data can be removed.

docs.title: tf_module_build_sa
docs.text: Build a SAP BTP subaccount from scretch

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: Name Version terraform >= 1.14.0 btp >= 1.22

docs.title: Providers
docs.text: Name Version btp >= 1.22

docs.title: Resources
docs.text: Name Type btp_subaccount.subaccount resource btp_subaccount_role_collection_assignment.sa_administrators resource btp_subaccount_role_collection_assignment.sa_viewers resource btp_subaccount_trust_configuration.create_trust resource

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Name Description Type Default Required btp_platform_idp FQDN of the SAP Cloud Identity Services which is used as Platform Identity Provider. string n/a yes btp_user_idp FQDN of the SAP Cloud Identity Services (IdP) to be trusted. string n/a yes parent_id UUID of the SAP BTP global account or directory that owns the subaccount. string n/a yes platform_administrators_group Platform identity-provider group assigned the Subaccount Administrator role collection. string "sa_administrators" no platform_viewers_group Platform identity-provider group assigned the Subaccount Viewer role collection. string "sa_viewers" no project_name Name of the project the subaccount belongs to. string n/a yes stage Stage of the subaccount to be created. string n/a yes subaccount_region Region where the subaccount shall be created in. string n/a yes trust_link_text User-facing link text for the business-user identity provider. string "Identity provider for business users" no trust_origin Origin identifier for the business-user trust configuration. string "custom.idp" no

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Name Description subaccount_id Technical ID of the subaccount. subaccount_name Display name of the subaccount. subaccount_subdomain Subdomain of the subaccount.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
The module creates resources in this order:

  1. A SAP BTP subaccount is created under the supplied parent ID.
  2. A trust configuration enables business-user logon through the supplied user identity provider.
  3. Role collection assignments grant subaccount administration and viewer access to groups from the platform identity provider.

Role collection assignments and trust configuration reference the created subaccount ID, so Terraform creates the subaccount before dependent resources.

docs.title: Development Subaccount
docs.text:
module "subaccount" {
    source = "../tf_module_build_sa"

    project_name      = "warehouse"
    stage             = "DEV"
    parent_id         = var.global_account_id
    subaccount_region = "eu10"
    btp_platform_idp  = "platform.accounts.ondemand.com"
    btp_user_idp      = "users.accounts.ondemand.com"
}

The example creates the subaccount SA warehouse - DEV and a subdomain derived from at-warehouse-dev.

docs.title: Operational Notes
docs.text: Apply this module before the Cloud Foundry and Workzone modules. The caller is responsible for managing provider authentication and protecting Terraform state, which contains resource identifiers.

docs.title: SAP BTP Subaccount Module
docs.text: Creates a SAP BTP subaccount, configures trust for business users, and assigns the Subaccount Administrator and Subaccount Viewer role collections to platform identity-provider groups.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Terraform 1.14.0 or later.
  • SAP BTP provider credentials with permission to create subaccounts, trust configurations, and role collection assignments.
  • Platform and business-user SAP Cloud Identity Services tenant host names.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
module "subaccount" {
    source = "../tf_module_build_sa"

    project_name      = "payments"
    stage             = "DEV"
    parent_id         = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
    subaccount_region = "eu10"
    btp_platform_idp  = "platform.accounts.ondemand.com"
    btp_user_idp      = "users.accounts.ondemand.com"
}

The generated name is SA <project_name> - <stage> and the generated subdomain is based on at-<project_name>-<stage>.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
This module provisions a SAP BTP subaccount for a named project and stage. It creates a deterministic subaccount name and subdomain, configures business-user trust, and grants the standard subaccount administrator and viewer role collections to configured platform identity-provider groups.

Use the outputs as inputs to dependent modules that enable Cloud Foundry or subscribe to SAP Build Work Zone.

docs.title: tf_module_enable_cf
docs.text: Enable a Cloud Foundry environment in an existing SAP BTP subaccount.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• A subaccount created by tf_module_build_sa or an equivalent configuration.
  • SAP BTP provider credentials that can assign entitlements and create Cloud Foundry environment instances.
  • A supported Cloud Foundry landscape region: cf-eu10-005 or cf-eu20-002.

Apply this module before tf_module_workzone. Pass the resulting cf_org_id to that module after environment provisioning completes.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text: Name Version terraform >= 1.14.0 btp >= 1.22

docs.title: Providers
docs.text: Name Version btp >= 1.22

docs.title: Resources
docs.text: Name Type btp_subaccount_entitlement.cf_runtime resource btp_subaccount_entitlement.cloud_foundry resource btp_subaccount_environment_instance.cloudfoundry resource

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Name Description Type Default Required cf_region Cloud Foundry landscape region for the environment instance. string n/a yes subaccount_id ID of the subaccount where Cloud Foundry will be enabled. string n/a yes subaccount_subdomain Lowercase DNS subdomain of the subaccount used to name Cloud Foundry resources. string n/a yes

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Name Description cf_instance_id Technical ID of the Cloud Foundry instance. cf_org_id Technical ID of the Cloud Foundry organization.

docs.title: tf_module_workzone
docs.text: Subscribe to SAP Build Work Zone Standard Edition and SAP Task Center.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• A SAP BTP subaccount with Cloud Foundry enabled.
  • A Cloud Foundry organization ID from tf_module_enable_cf.
  • SAP BTP and Cloud Foundry provider credentials with permissions to create subscriptions, service instances, service keys, spaces, and space roles.
  • A platform identity-provider group for Workzone administrators.

Apply this module after the Cloud Foundry environment is available. The module creates a Cloud Foundry space, subscribes the subaccount to Workzone, and provisions Workzone API and Task Center service instances. Terraform state may contain service-key credentials; protect it accordingly.

docs.title: Requirements

docs.title: Providers
